conditions.desktop: Unthrottled fresh Chromium context; browser cache disabled
conditions.mobile_4g: 390x844 viewport; 150ms network latency; 4Mbps down/1Mbps up; 4x CPU slowdown; fresh context and browser cache disabled

limitations: Analytics counts opted-in, measured visits. Unconsented or blocked visits are not represented; zero measured contacts does not prove zero actual inquiries.
Performance samples are three fresh-context Chromium runs per profile, not field Core Web Vitals or a Lighthouse score.
App-ready time is measured when the loading element is removed and Flutter view exists. Screenshots 500ms later confirmed visible content; this is not a standardized Time to Interactive metric.
Transfer totals cover resources completed at app-ready plus 500ms, not all subsequent page activity. The preview image completed in two desktop runs but not in the other runs.
Observed largest-contentful-paint corresponds to the initial Yro loading label, not the Flutter content, so it is not used to judge site readiness.
CPU throttling simulates slowdown on this browser host; it is not an actual mobile device test. CDN/browser-host conditions can differ from visitors.
Tests left Analytics consent unknown and made zero external requests, so they did not generate new production Analytics visits.
No application code, deployed release, key-event configuration, or custom-dimension settings changed during this read-only review.
